design.arena: additivity residual r = y - two-way additive prediction; marginals are blind to r by construction, so this is where the annotation model should win

predictors: gene-annotation ridge trained on training-cell residuals

refusal_to_conclude: the raw numbers show the annotation model 22 pp below random, but the pre-registered gate failed (negative cross-validated R2), so that number reflects a model fitting noise rather than the annotation model being bad; this round therefore says nothing about the annotation model
